claimChecks.section: Mapped SOC prerequisite, discrepancy, history, runtime and qualification sections
claimChecks.qualification: The current Premier Triage and Response aggregate lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+, paired SOAR and representative enablement. The 8.8 task prerequisites specify ES 8.7+ with paired SOAR, assistant enabled and investigation/connector permissions. It limits analysis to existing findings with AI triage, first ten when a detection produces more, about 200 findings per tenant daily, and frontier models. SOAR action/asset roles are additional. The 8.7 task guide uses historical AI SOC Analyst wording and the 8.7+ floor. The current aggregate names the Premier combined workflow without the earlier explicit Essentials component wording; the editions overview groups Triage under Premier. Current Cloud Connected CMP requires Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0 and separate setup requires SAIA 2.4+. The exact 2.3.6 Cloud Connected install guide excludes 2.2.0–2.3.6 and describes 2.4.0 as planned; 2.1.1 does not satisfy the stated floor. ES 8.8 GA on November 4 does not settle these prerequisites. The base assistant guide’s limited IL2/hosted-only scope and product regional tables do not establish regulated or per-agent rollout.
